conversation_kind_shape_check.name: conversation_kind_shape_check
conversation_kind_shape_check.value: (kind = 'DM' AND user1_id IS NOT NULL AND user2_id IS NOT NULL AND user1_id < user2_id AND lobby_id IS NULL) OR (kind = 'LOBBY' AND lobby_id IS NOT NULL AND user1_id IS NULL AND user2_id IS NULL) OR (kind = 'ROOM' AND lobby_id IS NULL AND user1_id IS NULL AND user2_id IS NULL)

attachment_encryption_shape_check.name: attachment_encryption_shape_check
attachment_encryption_shape_check.value: ("attachments"."encryption_mode"='LEGACY_PENDING' AND "attachments"."crypto_envelope" IS NULL) OR ("attachments"."encryption_mode"='E2EE' AND "attachments"."file_name"='' AND "attachments"."mime_type"='application/octet-stream' AND "attachments"."crypto_envelope" IS NULL AND "attachments"."file_size" BETWEEN 1 AND 5242880) OR ("attachments"."encryption_mode"='LOBBY_AEAD' AND chat_crypto_valid_envelope("attachments"."crypto_envelope",'LOBBY_AEAD','fg-lobby'))

message_encryption_shape_check.name: message_encryption_shape_check
message_encryption_shape_check.value: ("messages"."encryption_mode"='LEGACY_PENDING' AND "messages"."crypto_envelope" IS NULL AND "messages"."crypto_revision" IS NULL) OR ("messages"."content"='' AND "messages"."crypto_revision" IS NOT NULL AND "messages"."crypto_revision" BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991 AND chat_crypto_valid_envelope("messages"."crypto_envelope","messages"."encryption_mode",'fg-lobby'))

play_session_scheduled_at_check.name: play_session_scheduled_at_check
play_session_scheduled_at_check.value: (timing_type = 'now' AND scheduled_at IS NULL) OR (timing_type = 'scheduledAt' AND scheduled_at IS NOT NULL)

invitation_target_shape_check.name: invitation_target_shape_check
invitation_target_shape_check.value: (target_type = 'ROOM' AND play_session_id IS NULL) OR (target_type = 'PLAY_SESSION' AND play_session_id IS NOT NULL)

recruitment_scheduled_at_check.name: recruitment_scheduled_at_check
recruitment_scheduled_at_check.value: (timing_type = 'now' AND scheduled_at IS NULL) OR (timing_type = 'scheduledAt' AND scheduled_at IS NOT NULL)

recruitment_roblox_fields_check.name: recruitment_roblox_fields_check

notification_pref_email_forbidden_check.name: notification_pref_email_forbidden_check

report_target_shape_check.name: report_target_shape_check
report_target_shape_check.value: (target_type = 'USER' AND reported_user_id IS NOT NULL AND reported_message_id IS NULL AND target_id = reported_user_id) OR (target_type = 'MESSAGE' AND reported_message_id IS NOT NULL AND reported_user_id IS NULL AND target_id = reported_message_id)

pending_image_uploads_filename_check.name: pending_image_uploads_filename_check
pending_image_uploads_filename_check.value: length("pending_image_uploads"."file_name") BETWEEN 1 AND 255 AND position('/' in "pending_image_uploads"."file_name")=0 AND position(chr(92) in "pending_image_uploads"."file_name")=0

chat_crypto_recovery_cipher_check.name: chat_crypto_recovery_cipher_check
chat_crypto_recovery_cipher_check.value: octet_length("chat_crypto_recovery_backups"."ciphertext") BETWEEN 100 AND 16777216 AND "chat_crypto_recovery_backups"."ciphertext" LIKE '-----BEGIN MEGOLM SESSION DATA-----%' AND "chat_crypto_recovery_backups"."ciphertext" LIKE '%-----END MEGOLM SESSION DATA-----'

chat_crypto_interval_check.name: chat_crypto_interval_check
chat_crypto_interval_check.value: "chat_crypto_membership_intervals"."start_revision" BETWEEN 1 AND 9007199254740991 AND (("chat_crypto_membership_intervals"."end_revision" IS NULL AND "chat_crypto_membership_intervals"."left_at" IS NULL) OR ("chat_crypto_membership_intervals"."end_revision" IS NOT NULL AND "chat_crypto_membership_intervals"."left_at" IS NOT NULL AND "chat_crypto_membership_intervals"."end_revision">"chat_crypto_membership_intervals"."start_revision" AND "chat_crypto_membership_intervals"."end_revision"<=9007199254740991 AND "chat_crypto_membership_intervals"."left_at">="chat_crypto_membership_intervals"."joined_at"))

chat_crypto_upload_mode_check.name: chat_crypto_upload_mode_check
chat_crypto_upload_mode_check.value: ("chat_crypto_upload_drafts"."encryption_mode"='E2EE' AND "chat_crypto_upload_drafts"."device_id" IS NOT NULL AND "chat_crypto_upload_drafts"."envelope" IS NULL AND "chat_crypto_upload_drafts"."ciphertext_size" BETWEEN 1 AND 5242880 AND "chat_crypto_upload_drafts"."report_evidence_id" IS NULL) OR ("chat_crypto_upload_drafts"."encryption_mode" IN ('LOBBY_AEAD','REPORT_AEAD') AND "chat_crypto_upload_drafts"."ciphertext_size" BETWEEN 1 AND 8388608 AND chat_crypto_valid_envelope("chat_crypto_upload_drafts"."envelope",'LOBBY_AEAD',CASE WHEN "chat_crypto_upload_drafts"."encryption_mode"='REPORT_AEAD' THEN 'fg-report' ELSE 'fg-lobby' END) AND ("chat_crypto_upload_drafts"."encryption_mode"<>'REPORT_AEAD' OR "chat_crypto_upload_drafts"."message_id" IS NULL))

chat_crypto_upload_lifecycle_check.name: chat_crypto_upload_lifecycle_check
chat_crypto_upload_lifecycle_check.value: "chat_crypto_upload_drafts"."expires_at">"chat_crypto_upload_drafts"."created_at" AND (("chat_crypto_upload_drafts"."consumed_at" IS NULL AND "chat_crypto_upload_drafts"."message_id" IS NULL AND "chat_crypto_upload_drafts"."report_evidence_id" IS NULL) OR ("chat_crypto_upload_drafts"."consumed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "chat_crypto_upload_drafts"."consumed_at">="chat_crypto_upload_drafts"."created_at" AND "chat_crypto_upload_drafts"."consumed_at"<"chat_crypto_upload_drafts"."expires_at" AND (("chat_crypto_upload_drafts"."message_id" IS NOT NULL AND "chat_crypto_upload_drafts"."report_evidence_id" IS NULL) OR ("chat_crypto_upload_drafts"."message_id" IS NULL AND "chat_crypto_upload_drafts"."report_evidence_id" IS NOT NULL))))
